en.content:
Statement I : Dipole moment is a vector quantity and by convention it is depicted by a small arrow with tail on the negative centre and head pointing towards the positive centre.

Statement II : The crossed arrow of the dipole moment symbolizes the direction of the shift of charges in the molecules.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below :

options.content: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect

en.explanation:
The dipole moment is a vector quantity and is depicted by an arrow with tail on the positive centre and head pointing towards the negative centre. So, Statement-I is incorrect.

The crossed arrow of the dipole moment symbolizes the direction of the shift of charges in the molecules. So, Statement-II is correct.

कथन I: द्विघ्रुव आघूर्ण एक सदिश राशि है जिसे परम्परा के अनुसार एक छोटे तीर द्वारा दर्शाया जाता है जिसका पुच्छल सिरा ऋरणात्मक केन्द्र एवं अग्र सिरा घनात्मक केन्द्र की तरफ उन्मुख होता है।

en.content:
Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion A and the other is labelled as Reason R

Assertion A : Butylated hydroxy anisole when added to butter increases its shelf life.

Reason R : Butylated hydroxy anisole is more reactive towards oxygen than food.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below

options.content: A is correct but R is not correct
Both A and R are correct but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are correct and R is the correct explanation of A
A is not correct but R is correct

en.explanation:
Butylated hydroxy anisole is added to butter to
increase its shelf life from months to years as it is
more reactive towards oxygen than food.
Therefore, both Assertion and Reason are correct
and Reason is the correct explanation of Assertion.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। एक को अभिकथन एवं दूसरे का कारण कहा गया है।

अभिकथन : मक्खन में ब्यूटाइलेटेड हाइड्रॉक्सी ऐनिसोल मिलाने पर इसकी सेल्फ लाइफ बढ़ जाती है।

कारण : ब्यूटाइलेड हाइड्रॉक्सी ऐनिसोल भोजन की तुलना में ऑक्सीजन के प्रति अधिक अभिक्रियाशील है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों के प्रकाश में, नीचे दिए गए विरल्पों में से सही उत्तर चुनें:
